labels.variantDefinition: A sticky headline whose variable axes (weight, optical size, width) change with scroll position, so scrolling performs the font's range
labels.look: Black, uppercase art-deco sentence in a red-to-yellow gradient, going from hairline display to bold small text as words are added
labels.ux: Scroll drives weight, opsz and size of a sticky h1 inside a ~5-viewport section
labels.learn: Let the sentence announce the feature ('becomes a variable font…') while scroll demonstrates it

labels.look: Orange-to-purple gradient, white mono name and tagline, faded source code in the background, two outlined buttons
labels.learn: Ghosted code behind the headline places a programming font in its real habitat at zero cost

labels.variantDefinition: A centred, classical title-page or broadside composition: name, italic subtitle, rules and ornaments (often the family's own dingbats), stacked lines in mixed styles
labels.look: Cream, maroon wheat logo, big black serif name, italic tagline between rules, bread pictograms, small caps, 'free as always', scripts, numerals
labels.ux: Mostly static; lines link to download, donate and in-use sections
labels.learn: Each line of a broadside can show one more feature (small caps, Cyrillic, Greek, figures) while still reading as a title page

labels.look: White, spaced-caps 'FERN' between symmetric red fleuron clusters, italic subtitle, 'BUY ❖ TRIAL ❖ PDF' row
labels.ux: Buy anchor, trial form button (adds trial to cart), PDF specimen link
labels.learn: Build the frame from the family's own ornament glyphs: decoration that is also a specimen

labels.look: Full-bleed video of chrome 3D serif glyphs in a dark voxel city; slim 'Buy / APOC / Download Trial' bar; cut also has intro prose, faint giant marquee word, facts table
labels.ux: Autoplay video with mute toggle; click scrolls down; buy and trial links
labels.learn: Render the letters as 3D objects in a scene to give a display serif drama a flat specimen can't

labels.variantDefinition: A whimsical pangram-like sentence whose words switch weight and italic word by word, often rotating through several sentences, showing range in running text
labels.look: Charcoal, large white geometric sans sentence mixing thin italic, light and bold, a long dash, slide dots
labels.ux: Fade carousel of sentences, line-by-line reveal, draggable
labels.learn: Assign a different weight or italic to each word of a silly sentence: the range reads as rhythm, not a list

labels.look: Hot pink, giant yellow 'oi!' with a black extruded shadow, small award line, 'A clarendonesque on steroids'
labels.ux: Mostly static; a '<|' button, probably opens the menu
labels.learn: A two-letter interjection as the wordmark shows a fat display face better than the full name would

labels.look: Full-bleed video of brutalist concrete; 'AREA' stacked ten times from narrow to extended; then dark card with drop-cap intro and facts table
labels.ux: Autoplay video; sticky Buy / Download Trial pills
labels.learn: Stacking the name across all widths turns the wordmark into a width axis diagram

labels.look: Near-black band, big white 'MOVEMENT' with sheared joins, tiny 'Variable font' and '→ Trial fonts' below
labels.learn: A cover band (name plus two tiny labels) works as a hero inside a foundry's specimen template
